Bursar is building the financial control layer for autonomous AI agents on Robinhood Chain.

Instead of giving an agent an unrestricted wallet, a principal creates a private spending mandate that defines the budget, period cap, approved counterparties, permitted actions, asset rules and expiry. Every payment, trade or agent hire is checked onchain before settlement.

A mandate can be funded with approved treasury assets, used for eligible tokenized stocks and services, or supported through a separate collateralized lane. Bursar keeps the relationship between the principal, agent and spending activity private while allowing providers to verify that a payment is authorised.

It is built for people, teams and developers who want agents to operate with real capital without giving up control, privacy or accountability.
